summary.name: Gamma
summary.one_liner: Gamma is an AI-powered visual communication platform for creating presentations, documents, websites and social graphics from a chat-based agent.
use_cases: making social media carousels and graphics
converting existing PowerPoint or PDF files into new designs
summary.what_it_does: Gamma starts with a conversational AI agent that drafts an outline you can shape before generating a deck. You can describe a visual style, attach inspiration, or let it pick a look matched to your content and brand. Edits can be requested in chat, through smart layouts, or via freeform drag-and-drop design. The page says it can import PowerPoint and PDF files, pull content from tools such as Slack, Notion and Dropbox, and export to PowerPoint, PDF and other formats.
notable: Agent orchestrates multiple AI models for different parts of a deck
Outline-first workflow so you shape the story before design
Imports PowerPoint and PDF files with formatting kept
25+ connectors and export to PowerPoint and PDF
caveats: The page only says 'Start for free'; paid tiers and limits are not described on this page
Export fidelity and connector details are marketing claims, not verified here
